def equation(t, x, v, params):
    tf = np.sqrt(t)
    c = np.cos(params[2]*tf+params[3]); s = np.sin(params[2]*tf+params[3])
    c2 = np.cos(2*params[2]*tf+2*params[3]); s2 = np.sin(2*params[2]*tf+2*params[3])
